title: Recheck marker-create freshness after persisted anchor resolution
outcome: Conversation marker creation resolves persisted anchors outside the state lock but, unlike marker update, does not perform a compare-and-swap freshness recheck before committing. Concurrent transcript or session mutation can make the resolved anchor positions stale by the time the marker is inserted.
acceptance: Marker creation captures the relevant session revision or mutation stamp, resolves anchors, and rechecks freshness before committing. On concurrent mutation it retries safely or returns a deterministic conflict without storing stale anchors. Add a create-path race regression matching the update-path protection.
